Numerous clinical trials have been conducted to evaluate the efficacy and safety of mavacamten across various patient populations, including those with obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (oHCM) and non-obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy [NCT03470545, NCT03442764, NCT05582395]. Interventional studies have ranged from Phase 1 pharmacokinetic assessments in healthy subjects to Phase 3 and Phase 4 trials investigating clinical responses, safety, and long-term outcomes [NCT03470545, NCT05135871, NCT05174416, NCT05719805, NCT07807384]. Several observational studies are also underway to monitor real-world effectiveness, patient-reported outcomes, and long-term safety in diverse global cohorts [NCT06338202, NCT06372457, NCT06551129, NCT07383025]. Completed trials have included enrollment sizes ranging from 13 to 251 participants, while ongoing or planned studies estimate enrollments as high as 2,000 [NCT03496168, NCT03470545, NCT07695272]. Primary outcomes frequently focus on changes in left ventricular outflow tract (LVOT) gradients, New York Heart Association (NYHA) functional class, and the incidence of treatment-emergent adverse events [NCT03470545, NCT06338202, NCT07107373, NCT07846059]. Research sponsors include organizations such as Bristol-Myers Squibb, MyoKardia, Inc., and various academic institutions [NCT03470545, NCT03442764, NCT06551129, NCT07695272].
